projects.title: PMO Capital Portfolio Dashboard
projects.description: A SAP-integrated Power BI dashboard tracking a PKR 5.73 billion capital portfolio across 372 active projects for university leadership.
projects.problem: Leadership had no unified view of a PKR 5.73 billion capital portfolio spanning 372 active projects — data lived separately across SAP ERP, Smartsheet, and Oracle HIMS, and monthly KPI reporting relied on ~20 hours of manual Excel consolidation.
projects.solution: Architected a live Power BI dashboard integrating SAP ERP at WBS and purchase-order granularity with Smartsheet and Oracle HIMS via API, built on a star-schema data model as the single source of truth. Designed a KPI governance framework across 13 strategic objectives (Financial, Stakeholder, Employee Development, Compliance) covering 20+ metrics with monthly variance analysis.
projects.impact: Cut monthly KPI reporting effort by 70% (~20 hours to ~6 hours), reached ≥97% data accuracy and ≥80% management adoption, and became the tool university leadership uses directly for multi-billion PKR capital allocation decisions.

projects.title: Healthcare Executive Analytics Dashboard | KPI & Performance Insights
projects.description: Consolidates every department's separate reports — financial, patient, operational, quality — into one executive view leadership actually opens.
projects.problem: Hospital leadership relied on multiple disconnected departmental dashboards and reports, with no single consolidated executive view of real-time performance across financial, patient, operational, and quality metrics — creating fragmented insight and manual effort to piece together the full picture.
projects.solution: Designed an interactive executive analytics solution consolidating financial, patient, operational, and quality data into a unified management reporting experience, using Power BI, DAX, Power Query, and data modeling. Covers KPI monitoring, revenue and budget analysis, hospital comparison, department and consultant performance, patient-flow analysis, and quality and safety indicators — one entry point instead of six. Refreshes on a 5-hour cycle against 5 years of history, with a 10-day incremental refresh window to keep loads fast. The portfolio version uses anonymized/synthetic data to demonstrate the reporting approach while protecting confidential information.
projects.impact: Replaced multiple disconnected departmental dashboards and reports with a single real-time executive view. Leadership can compare hospital performance, analyze department and consultant productivity, monitor patient flow, and review quality and safety indicators from one consolidated source — turning operational data into decisions instead of manual report compilation.

projects.title: Organization Expense Management Dashboard — Multi-Site KPI Tracking
projects.description: Expense governance dashboard benchmarking direct, indirect, and allocation spend against revenue across 4 Major Organization sites, five years back.
projects.problem: A multi-site healthcare organization required real-time visibility into organizational expenses across 4 Major Organization sites — covering direct, indirect, and allocation expense categories against monthly targets. Manual reporting through SAP extracts caused delays and limited leadership's ability to act on budget variances in time.
projects.solution: Built an expense monitoring dashboard integrating live SAP ERP data via API with Smartsheet target data in Power BI, growing automatically as five years of organizational spend accumulates. KPI cards show actual vs. target utilization across total, direct, indirect, and allocation expenses — each category also benchmarked against gross revenue (Expense vs. Revenue %) for a financial efficiency view most expense trackers skip. A live search box on top expenses by unit head, full cross-filter click-through on any bar or head, and hospital/expense-type slicers round out the drill-down. Runs on Power BI Service on a daily refresh, 20-day incremental window.
projects.impact: Tracks PKR 5.78 billion in total expenses in real time across 4 Major Organization sites (PKR 2.12 billion in the current financial year alone), with direct, indirect, and allocation KPIs visible against target at every level. Leadership now identifies overspending unit heads instantly via live search and cross-filtering, and manual SAP extraction for monthly expense reporting has been eliminated entirely.

projects.title: Pharmacy Financial KPI Dashboard — Multi-Site Revenue & Profitability Tracking
projects.description: Departmental P&L for pharmacy operations — gross revenue, operating profit, and net income streamed straight from POS data across 3 sites.
projects.problem: Hospital pharmacy leadership required real-time financial visibility across 3 sites — tracking gross revenue, operating profit, and net income against monthly targets. Manual reporting cycles caused significant delays, meaning by the time financial results reached top management, the numbers were already outdated.
projects.solution: Built a pharmacy financial KPI dashboard wired directly to live POS transaction data via REST API, blended with Google Sheets target data in Power BI — a different data source and refresh cadence than the organization's SAP-based dashboards, since retail-style pharmacy sales move faster than capital or expense cycles. KPI cards on gross revenue, operating profit, and net income each carry achievement percentage and actual-vs-target ratio; a monthly revenue trend overlays actual expense on hover; OPD/IPD revenue gets its own donut breakdown; and a collapsible filter panel adds a custom date calendar (year/quarter/month) alongside site selection. Refreshes every 4 hours on Power BI Service, with 5 years archived.
projects.impact: Gross revenue target achieved at 100.02% (PKR 197.96M vs. PKR 197.91M target), with operating profit (PKR 62.44M, 31.54% of revenue) and net income (PKR 49.97M, 25.24% of revenue) tracked against targets across all 3 sites. OPD and IPD revenue are monitored separately with utilization percentages, and manual financial reporting cycles have been eliminated entirely — top management and pharmacy heads now access validated live financials instead of delayed manual reports.

projects.title: Enterprise EMR Rollout Across 14+ Departments
projects.description: Not a dashboard — a full system go-live. End-to-end EMR implementation and 500+ user adoption across OPD, IPD, Lab, Radiology, Pharmacy, and Billing.
projects.problem: The organization needed an enterprise-wide EMR live across 14+ departments with full adoption from clinicians, nurses, pharmacists, and administrative staff — not just a technical go-live.
projects.solution: Led EMR implementation end-to-end from requirements gathering through go-live across 14+ departments including OPD, IPD, Laboratory, Radiology, Pharmacy, and Billing. Trained 500+ end users and assisted with LIS/LAS and PACS integrations, UAT, and post-implementation support.
projects.impact: Achieved full system adoption across clinical and administrative departments, with 500+ end users trained and onboarded.
